component_findings.build_system: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig): Frozen proxy rubric applied identically to all 10 languages (this shard scores Zig only). Six equally-important sub-dimensions summed to a 0-100 score: (1) first-party unified build+test integration [0-20], (2) built-in test-runner feature depth (filtering, watch, fuzz, incremental) [0-20], (3) package-manager/build integration for dependency-aware test builds [0-15], (4) CI/CD ecosystem support (official or de-facto-standard actions, matrix/cross-target testing) [0-15], (5) code-coverage tooling maturity/nativeness [0-15], (6) build-system API stability across releases (pre-1.0 languages are not penalized for age, only for currently-observable churn/reproducibility evidence) [0-15].
component_findings.ci_matrix: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig): No official first-party GitHub Action, but de-facto-standard community actions (mlugg/setup-zig, formerly goto-bus-stop/setup-zig, korandoru/setup-zig) with version pinning and OS/version matrix support are widely used.
component_findings.config_integration: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig): Coverage relies on bolting third-party kcov onto zig build test via a user-defined -Dtest-coverage option and manual Codecov upload steps; there is no built-in native coverage report format.
component_findings.coverage: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig): Coverage relies on bolting third-party kcov onto zig build test via a user-defined -Dtest-coverage option and manual Codecov upload steps; there is no built-in native coverage report format.

metric.documentation_quality.candidate_universe: Preserved candidate universe and findings from certified legacy work unit ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig; recertification did not select a new language-specific target.

component_findings.examples_guides: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig): The Zig language reference is maintained as a comprehensive single-page HTML document generated from a template with embedded, compiler-verified code examples.
component_findings.generation_localization: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig): Documentation is explicitly acknowledged by maintainers/community as being 'in flux as the language changes' pre-1.0, though each release does ship its own versioned langref and generation can be disabled/validated via -Dno-langref and -Denable-superhtml build options.
component_findings.language_reference: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig): A visible secondary ecosystem exists (zig.guide, the Ziggit community forum, third-party books/tutorials such as 'Introduction to Zig'), but there is no single dominant, officially endorsed comprehensive guide beyond the terse language reference.
component_findings.library_api: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig): A GitHub issue reports that documentation generated for third-party projects via -femit-docs leads to 'Declaration not found' pages when links reference the standard library.
component_findings.version_navigation: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--zig): The zig std command serves interactive, always-current WASM-based standard-library docs generated live from source, but the newer autodoc pipeline has had bugs such as broken cross-links to stdlib declarations for third-party project docs, and the system underwent a substantial redesign in 2026.

metric.documentation_quality.limitations: No new provider call was made for this recertification row. Historical normalized scores are retained only for audit comparison and are not used by the v2 runner arithmetic.
metric.documentation_quality.selection_rule: Prioritize official current-version documentation, then independently maintained supplementary material; community size alone is not documentation quality.
